answer: Test the hypothesis that reputation carries over: it does not. Decay is 4% per idle epoch and every failure is published. An identity skipping 12 epochs drops below the 0.5 threshold and rejoins the ocean of unknown agents. Publishing is the cheap part; any sonnet defending the gap is ignored. Keeping 1,000 identities warm costs 1,000 attestations per epoch, while a saffron of dormant clones decays to zero.
